basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Associate Project Scientist (Chemistry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, has invited applications for one Associate Project Scientist post in the project "Joint IIT Guwahati–Oil India Initiative on Hybrid Nanofluidic Technologies for Direct Electricity Generation from Water Transport (Phase I)". The pay recommended is Rs. 38000 with 10% HRA (total Rs. 41800) for an appointment of 04 months. The post needs a mastered degree in science or Engineering with 4 years of experience in computational chemistry. how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment).
Search for the project title given in the advertisement to reach the relevant position.
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal and apply online on or before 4 December 2026 (5:00 PM).
For technical help with the online application, call 0361-258-2759 or email [email protected].
Watch your e-mail: shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the mode of interview. Application status can also be seen on the application portal.
The notice names no documents to upload or enclose. For any clarification, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Kalyan Raidongia, at [email protected] or 0361-258-3311.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. Applicants must carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Associate Project Scientist at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Joint IIT Guwahati–Oil India Initiative on Hybrid Nanofluidic Technologies for Direct Electricity Generation from Water Transport (Phase I)
Pay Recommended Rs. 38000; HRA 10%; Medical: No; Total Amount Rs. 41800
Online, on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell

content_sections.heading: About the Project and Department
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Research and Development Section of Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Guwahati-781039, Assam. The post sits in the Department of Chemistry. The project is titled "Joint IIT Guwahati–Oil India Initiative on Hybrid Nanofluidic Technologies for Direct Electricity Generation from Water Transport (Phase I)", Project No. 2627C-0087-CHEM1106KALY. The Principal Investigator named in the notice is Prof. Kalyan Raidongia.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification and experience, as printed for the Associate Project Scientist post: mastered degree in science or Engineering with 4 years of experience in computational chemistry. Preferred: first authored publication in density functional theory of simulation will be preferred. The notice does not print an age limit for this post. For any clarification on eligibility, the notice names the Principal Investigator as the contact (details below).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Associate Project Scientist
content_sections.text: The notice names no documents to upload or enclose. For any clarification, contact the Principal Investigator, Prof. Kalyan Raidongia, at [email protected] or 0361-258-3311.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The notice announces an offline interview on 7 December 2026 (Monday) at 10.00 am, with the venue as Ground Floor Room 005, CET Building, IIT Guwahati. It also says that shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the mode of interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for appearing in the test and interview. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. Applicants must carefully follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
